intro.title: FUNDA — Shopping Cart Badge Counter
intro.body: In this lesson you will build a Shopping Cart Badge — the small numerical indicator on a cart icon that updates in real time as items are added, removed, or quantity-adjusted across any page of the application. You will implement the cart state using Angular Signals, derive the item count and subtotal using computed(), and observe side effects (persisting to localStorage) using effect(). The badge component itself uses OnPush change detection, staying in sync through Angular's signal graph without a single manual subscription.
intro.usecase: Cart badges, notification counters, and unread-message badges appear in virtually every consumer-facing application — e-commerce, social media, email clients, and project management tools. They are also the canonical example for explaining Angular Signals in interviews. Building this widget forces you to understand the difference between signal(), computed(), and effect() and how they replace BehaviorSubject patterns with zero boilerplate.
